static_traits.name: 李雯
static_traits.family_status: Father is a missionary; husband is a US Army soldier; first pregnancy
static_traits.social_status: 居住在乡村，线下社交机会较少；与丈夫关系Good但其常外出执勤，社区内交友困难
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems; has not received psychotherapy; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、合作度高，能描述自动化思维与担忧；语气平稳，态度积极；能识do not极端化（非黑即白）思维倾向

basic_info.main_problem: 我感到被孤立，并认为自己缺乏人际交往能力，导致Loneliness和自卑感。自结婚后搬到乡下的房子，这种孤立感开始出现，在怀孕后进一步加剧；我担心在缺乏沟通能力的情况下独自带娃。尤其当丈夫外出执勤时，这种感受几乎每天发生。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because I realize that feelings of isolation and inferiority are affecting my mental health and may affect my ability to care for my newborn.
growth_experiences: 结婚后搬到乡下的房子，线下社交显著减少；自觉人际能力下降，Loneliness与自卑感逐渐加重，怀孕后进一步Reinforcement；尤其在丈夫外出执勤时每日感到Loneliness和Anxiety，担心独自带娃缺乏沟通与处理事务的能力。
原生家庭背景：父亲是传教士（Not mentioned具体影响）。

special_situations.event: Husband away on duty; oneself alone in the house in the countryside
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果have not稳定的陪伴与支持，我就without法应对日常与育儿事务
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少向丈夫表达Loneliness与Self-doubt，尽量独自承受情绪
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: have not人可求助，我会一直很Loneliness

special_situations.event: Thinking about soon being alone with the newborn
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我社交与沟通能力not足，就会成为not称职的Mother
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 提前放大风险、not断自我检查与担忧以试图“准备充分”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会处理not好一切，我not是一个好Mother

special_situations.event: Still feels disconnected after joining an online forum
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果线上交流have not立刻带来被接纳感，说明我根本have not人际能力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 进一步减少线下尝试，把注意力集中在能证明“我not行”的线索上
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 连在线上我都很not合群，我真的have not社交能力

special_situations.event: 搬到乡下、面对线下Reduced socializing的环境
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我住在乡下还without法结识朋友，原因只能是我not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Directly binds housing choice to own ability and keeps blaming oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我之所以一个人住在乡下，是因为我have not人际skill

core_conflict.wish: Longing for companionship, understanding, and support (especially at the stage of impending pregnancy and parenting)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕表达依赖或脆弱后被忽视、被评价为without能，或给对方增添负担
defense_goal: 通过减少表达与Self-denial来降低Being rejected或被责备的风险
Maintains a certain emotional distance to gain a sense of security

object_relations.self_representation: Loneliness而not够好的准妈妈、缺乏社交能力的人
object_relations.object_representation: Significant others (husband/people around) are busy and find it hard to provide timely responses and support

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当谈到是否向丈夫表达自己的Loneliness与Self-doubt时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为表达需求会给丈夫添麻烦、被视为软弱或without能（对他人的反应持负性Anticipation）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 轻描淡写情绪，避免直接提出需求，use委婉语气并缩短自我暴露的篇幅。

manifestations: 搬到乡下后线下Reduced socializing，感到被孤立
丈夫常外出执勤，Being alone时间长
怀孕后担心独自带娃、without支持与沟通

contact_model.definition: 个体存在not良的自我Reflection与自我苛责，过多自我限制，对接触过于小心谨慎。
manifestations: 把not完美等同失败（“如果not能立刻交到朋友，就说明我永远not行”）
频繁自我贴标签（“我have not社交能力”）
担心被评价为without能而减少表达需求

contact_model.definition: 将本应向外发出的能量Turning against the self，Repression对他人表达或寻求帮助的冲动。
manifestations: not愿向丈夫表达Loneliness与Self-doubt，选择独自承受
Reduces face-to-face help-seeking or exploring offline support channels

Has tried seeking support and connection through online forums
negative_force: 居住在乡村导致线下Reduced socializing
Self-denial与灾难化/预测not yet来的思维加重Anxiety
not愿向丈夫表达Loneliness与Self-doubt，降低获得支持的机会
对独自照料婴儿的担心Reinforcementwithout力与not称职感

target_behavior.behavior: 回避线下社交并反复Self-denial（“我have not社交能力”），伴随Loneliness与Anxiety
antecedent: Thinking about soon caring for the newborn alone
Lives in a rural environment with few offline social opportunities
target_behavior.core_reason: 对自身社交能力的负性核心信念与灾难化/预测not yet来的自动化思维（担心成为not称职的Mother、without法沟通与应对）
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的Being rejected/被评判与失败，短期降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 持续Loneliness与Anxiety、日常自我照料受影响，社交skill与支持网络难以建立
